Thermolysin non-catalytic Ca₂ site (Geobacillus / B. thermoproteolyticus, NOT Acidithiobacillus — bin label upstream is wrong). Native: 2× Ca²⁺ in a hard-O carboxylate cage. The site is Ca-evolved by sequence but Ln³⁺-permissive by geometry; Ln³⁺ substitution demonstrated in vitro by Holmquist & Vallee 1974 + Matthews lab 1970s structures, but historically presumed biologically irrelevant. Discriminator independently identified this as Ln-evolved at +24.4 — i.e. picked up a 50-year-old chemistry result from a blind scan. Strong validation: the discriminator detects genuine hard-cation pockets, not just XoxF-fold homology. Implies in vivo Ln substitution may actually occur in Geobacillus habitats (geothermal / weathered rock — Ln-rich environments). Methodology paper figure candidate.
